rows.available: Continuous cochains for a compact lattice are the inverse limit of its finite quotients, and discrete torsion cochains are the filtered direct limit. Cohomology has the stated lim1 exact sequence; finite cohomology gives zero lim1 and finitely generated compact cohomology.
rows.needed: The actual finite-coefficient cohomology and local-condition systems admit exact compact/discrete passage with no omitted lim1 term.
rows.argument: Use the finite-group stabilization argument in proof15 for every kernel/image system. Keep compact multiplication-by2 adjoint to discrete inclusion as fixed in proof9. Support S and E are fixed throughout.
rows.boundary: No inverse limit over a family of curves or growing support is taken.

rows.available: For finite S and finite G_(K,S)-module M of order invertible in O_(K,S), all H^r(G_(K,S),M) are finite.
rows.needed: Finiteness for every E[2^n] and every cohomological degree used in the limit and cone sequence.
rows.argument: S contains2, infinity and the bad primes; the finite module is unramified away from S. Its order is a power of2, hence invertible in the S-integer ring.
rows.boundary: Finiteness at each n does not assert uniform cardinality in n; only eventual stabilization of images at a fixed n is used.

rows.available: For an abelian variety over a characteristic-zero nonarchimedean local field, the compact rational-points group is dual to H^1 of the dual abelian variety. It has an open finite-index additive integer-ring subgroup; the duality is compatible with the finite Kummer and Weil pairings.
rows.needed: For the actual elliptic E/Q_v, derived Kummer has full degree-zero torsion and its finite Kummer image is selfannihilating. The compact quotient has rank1 at2 and vanishes at v not2.
rows.argument: Use the principal polarization and finite Kummer compatibility. Local analytic structure gives rank one for the 2-primary completion at v=2 and rank zero at other finite places. The dual of H1(Qv,E)[2^n] is E(Qv)/2^n; the discrete transition is multiplication by2. Thus the Tate module is dual to E(Qv) tensor Q2/Z2, giving the stated compact quotient. The full compact E(Qv) is dual to the full H1(Qv,E), not to this Tate module.
rows.boundary: This source applies to finite places only. The real Kummer complex and minus-line calculation are separately retained.

rows.available: For a finite local Galois module, local cup product with its Tate dual is a perfect pairing in degrees i and2-i, normalized by the local invariant.
rows.needed: Compact H2(Q_v,T) is dual to H0(Q_v,D), and the global-to-local tail map is dual to restriction.
rows.argument: Apply finite local duality to E[2^n], using the elliptic Weil self-duality. Pass to the adjoint compact/discrete systems by proof15. This preserves the maps and identifies each finite-place H2 length with g_v.
rows.boundary: No real ordinary H0 is replaced by Tate H0; the finite real source is separate.

available.statement: For every elliptic curve E/Q, the abelian group E(Q) is finitely generated.
available.hypotheses: E is an elliptic curve overQ.
available.normalizations: The full rational-points group, with its finite torsion subgroup.
available.limit_order: Fix E/Q; the theorem gives finite generation, not generators or an effective rank bound.

rows.needed: Under corank-zero Selmer, E(Q) has rankzero and finite2primary torsion; its compact completion and its finite quotients are the actual global Kummer terms.
rows.argument: Mordell–Weil finite generation and the all-place Kummer sequence show that E(Q) tensor Q2/Z2 has corank equal to rank E(Q). Its injection into the corankzero discrete Selmer group forces rankzero.
rows.boundary: No analytic-rank theorem or unconditional finite Sha is inferred.
